* '''Playtest''' ([[Cloud City: Dining Room (V) (Playtest)]]): Playtest image: PC card image of 2 December 2025<ref name="ht-cc-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d7881b2/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual26-Dark/large/cloudcitydiningroom.gif cloudcitydiningroom.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/d7881b28d79e33541236559133b4d9583b43812d d7881b2] (2 December 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. The title strips print “•DINING ROOM” (top, Light Side) and “•DDINING ROOM” (bottom, Dark Side; doubled D). Text: “'''Light Side:''' Chewie, Han, Leia, and your Lando move to here using landspeed for free. '''Dark Side:''' Vader, your Boba Fett, and your Lando deploy -1 here. May ▼ Lando here.”
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image of 2 December 2025<ref name="ht-cc-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b65c961/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual26-Dark/large/cloudcitydiningroom.gif cloudcitydiningroom.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/b65c961784833ee85707666198a3d8bd794c032c b65c961] (2 December 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. What changed from the previous image: both title strips now print “•CLOUD CITY: DINING ROOM” (same day). Game text unchanged. Text: “'''Light Side:''' Chewie, Han, Leia, and your Lando move to here using landspeed for free. '''Dark Side:''' Vader, your Boba Fett, and your Lando deploy -1 here. May ▼ Lando here.”
What changed on the card image (crops of the two published images, unchanged pixels):

Versions follow Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version (the PC's own E marks count only its announced errata). 
The Original card face was also printed as a slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata (Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf)<ref name="sheet26-20251226">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2025”; file created 26 December 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 26]] (8 December 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 2, with the same words. Under the slip-and-composite rule (Bill, 17 November 2026) the slip and that card image are one version on this page; the former page ''Cloud City: Dining Room (V) (Errata)'' redirects there.
